Not because your product is flawed, but because your geography is. This is not a temporary inconvenience. It’s a permanent exclusion from the platforms that power global commerce. The solution isn’t a workaround. It’s infrastructure sovereignty. No-KYC payment gateways are the first step. They decouple your revenue from platforms that can revoke access at will. This is not about avoiding compliance—it’s about [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-everything-you-need-17|Building a]] on infrastructure you control. Here’s how it works, why it matters, and how to deploy it today.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

No-KYC payment gateways are payment processors that do not require identity verification for either the seller or the buyer. They operate on blockchain networks, where transactions are verified by network nodes, not by a central authority. This eliminates the need for intermediaries like banks or payment processors that enforce KYC (Know Your Customer) regulations. For digital creators in regions like Kenya, where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, this means access to a global market without geographic restrictions. It’s not about anonymity—it’s about sovereignty. You control the infrastructure. No platform can shut you down. No currency collapse can erase your revenue stream. This is base-layer commerce, built to withstand the pressures of financial isolation.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture is modular and decentralized. Your store runs on static hosting platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally distributed. Backend logic is handled by serverless functions like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which execute code on demand without servers. Orders are stored in databases like Supabase or Google Sheets, and files are delivered via object storage like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payments are processed through NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges a flat 0.5% fee. When a buyer sends payment, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and fires a webhook to your backend. The backend confirms the payment, logs the order, and delivers the product automatically. No middlemen. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators who sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. If you’ve been locked out of Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, or Paddle, this is your solution. It’s also for creators who refuse to rent their commerce stack. With this architecture, you own everything after deployment. No platform has access to your data, your revenue, or your customers. It’s designed for regions where financial isolation is a reality, not a hypothetical. Originating in Zimbabwe, COREMERCH’s stacks are pressure-tested against currency collapse, payment rejection, and infrastructure failure. This isn’t a workaround—it’s a permanent solution.
No platform can shut down your store. You own the infrastructure.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack is composed of interoperable components. Hosting is handled by GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, both of which serve static sites globally for free. Backend logic is executed by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which process payments, log orders, and deliver files. Order data is stored in Supabase (a serverless Postgres database) or Google Sheets, depending on the stack. File delivery is managed via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, both of which offer affordable, scalable storage. Payments are processed by NOWPayments, which supports cryptocurrencies like USDT on BSC, Solana, and TRON for low-fee transactions. Each component is independent but integrates seamlessly. The result is a commerce stack that’s fast, secure, and fully owned by you.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It includes all six blueprints, seven templates, and instant access to the source code. Choose a stack based on your needs—Stack 01 for simplicity or Stack 02 for scalability. Deploy your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Configure your backend with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Set up NOWPayments to accept crypto payments in USD, converted at transaction time. Test end-to-end to ensure automatic file delivery. Once deployed, you own the infrastructure. No subscriptions. No platform fees. Lifetime access. This is how you build a commerce stack that can’t be taken away.

They enable digital creators to accept payments globally without relying on platforms like Stripe or PayPal. Transactions are verified on-chain, and fees are typically lower than traditional processors. For creators in regions with restricted access to global payment platforms, this provides a sovereign alternative to sell digital products like ebooks, courses, and software.

It’s available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit is designed for digital creators who want full ownership of their commerce stack, without relying on platforms that can restrict access based on geography or compliance.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Decide between Stack 01 (GitHub Pages + Apps Script) or Stack 02 (Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase).
2. Set up hosting: Deploy your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for free.
3. Configure backend: Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment verification and file delivery.
4. Integrate payments: Connect NOWPayments to accept crypto payments with a 0.5% fee.
5. Test end-to-end: Ensure payments trigger automatic file delivery to buyers.
6. Load products: Add your ebooks, courses, or templates to the system.
7. Launch: Publish your store and start selling globally.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is a no-KYC payment gateway?
A no-KYC payment gateway is a blockchain-based processor that does not require identity verification. It enables transactions without intermediaries like banks or traditional payment processors.
Why can’t I use Stripe or PayPal in Kenya?
Stripe and PayPal restrict access in certain regions due to regulatory, economic, or compliance issues. This leaves creators without a way to accept global payments.
How does NOWPayments work?
NOWPayments verifies crypto transactions on-chain and fires a webhook to your backend. It supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements.
What if I don’t know how to code?
The Complete Builder Kit includes templates and blueprints that require minimal customization. You can deploy a fully functional store without writing code from scratch.
Can I accept USD payments with this system?
Yes, NOWPayments converts crypto payments to USD at transaction time. Buyers pay in crypto, and you receive the equivalent value in USD.
